'''Jon Woodland''' was the random-draw winner of Puzzle 5 of the 1997 Dagobah Contest, [[Never Tell Me The Odds]].<ref name="sol5">[http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution5.html The Dagobah Contest], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327214451/http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution5.html Internet Archive]</ref> He was Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Red 24 in Victoria, BC. The slot is marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />
